design_source.title: Talent Signal V1 完整产品与系统设计｜目标驱动智能 CRM（iOS + Backend + Claude Agent SDK）

scenario.persona: independent recruiter managing several live executive searches
scenario.starting_state: ordinary authenticated app launch after a meaningful candidate conversation
scenario.task: identify the target outcome that deserves attention, inspect exact evidence, and review one safe next step without creating an external effect
scenario.known_context: synthetic Leila Hartmann and Chief Product Officer search fixtures
scenario.success_condition: the current build truthfully demonstrates the Notion V2 Pursuit-centered evidence-to-review loop and all tested state transitions

frozen_evidence.details: Release build passed and 31 unit tests passed; CandidateSignalUITests.testRelationshipCaptureRequiresCurrentOwnerAndCompilesGoldWiki failed after the authorized localhost relationship fixture was unavailable. The localhost sync test was skipped.

review_constraints: Review only this frozen baseline; do not infer later implementation state.
Treat unrun production, real-device, VoiceOver-user, and field evidence as missing rather than passed.
Do not process or request real candidate content.
Do not average safety or accessibility failures into visual polish.
